anya: quick check — morning k6 burst run (test id k6-73) showed a p95 spike after ~45m, sustained for ~6m. uploading short logs. cc @cheng @rafa :eyes:
cheng: can you drop the k6 cmd + config and which runtime nodes this hit? also timeline of deploys pls
anya: sure. run command:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 60m --rps 0 scripts/realistic-burst.js --summary-export=out.json
# script uses arrivalRate ramp to simulate sudden bursts, batch_size=16
```
anya: summary: avg latency ~120ms, p95 jumped to 420ms, p99 ~980ms, error rate stayed <0.1%. affected nodes: runtime-2a, runtime-3a. logs: `s3://redwood-perf/k6/k6-73/out.json`
rafa: could be KV cache eviction thrash or a GC tail. did you see growth in heap or cache misses?
anya: heap for runtime-3a rose ~30% before the spike, then a bunch of short GC pauses (~10-15ms) logged. attaching small log excerpt:
`INF  avg=120ms p95=420ms p99=980ms gc_pause=12ms node=runtime-3a mem_rss=7.8G kv_cache_evictions=312`
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rtime-service@v2.14 by alex at 1717021000 — status: success
cheng: that deploy timestamp overlaps the run window? maybe a warmup + rollout coincided. can we correlate request distribution to node assignment? add route tag in next run (route=prod-sim)
alex: i kicked that deploy earlier — good catch. i can run a controlled canary tonight at 23:00 UTC if folks want. who owns watching traces + flamegraphs? :+1:
anya: thanks. canary sounds good. for the rerun please add `--summary-export` + enable pprof on runtime pods for 10m around the peak window. also limit rps to 150 for first 20m then remove cap to reproduce burst slowly
cheng: add this to the k6 wrapper env: `BATCH_SIZE=32 K6_ARRIVAL_RATE=burst` and collect `/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30` every 2m. i'll add a small script to pull profiles automatically.
rafa: i can own flamegraphs. will collect CPU + heap profiles and upload to s3: `s3://redwood-perf/flamegraphs/k6-73-rerun/`. will also run `perf record` on the node if we can repro on a dedicated host.
anya: assigning ticket INF-312 to this run and adding checklist: reproduce, collect pprof, upload flamegraphs, correlate deploy timeline.
alex: i'll schedule the canary, start at 23:00 UTC and ping here when it starts. if anyone else wants to join live monitoring pls react or DM.
rafa: on it — will upload the first set in ~45m.
cheng: i'll wire the auto-pprof script into the test harness and open a small PR — pinging @anya for quick review when done.
anya: thanks all. small follow-ups: 1) try batch_size=32, 2) keep kv cache warm prefilling keys for 10m, 3) capture netstat snapshots at spike start.
alex: :thumbsup:
rafa: copying notes to INF-312 and closing loop after uploads.
anya: closing for now — will reopen thread with rerun artifacts. :rocket:
